_comment: Upstream design-pattern tracker for brycewang-stanford/Auto-Empirical-Research-Skills (repository default CC-BY-SA-4.0; vendored sub-collections carry their own licences). ERC borrows design patterns only and rewrites them natively; no text, code or prompts are copied, so ERC is not bound by ShareAlike. StatsPAI-specific skills, the de-AIGC / watermark-removal goal, the p-hacking search engine, the 70+ vendored community collections and the numeric benchmark are excluded.
name: aers
label: Auto-Empirical-Research-Skills
policy: design-pattern-only; no text, code or prompt copying; StatsPAI binding, de-AIGC/watermark removal, p-hacking engine, vendored community collections and numeric benchmark are excluded
last_audit_note: Baseline from README, docs/LICENSE_AUDIT.md and a sparse checkout of the seven in-house skills (00.1-00.3, 48, 50, 69, 73), eval-harness/, benchmark/ and aers_score/. The 70+ vendored community collections were not read.

adopted_patterns.note: From the p-hacking detection idea: every specification run is logged (paper_tools.py spec log/summary), results link to it with --spec, academic-review audits tried vs reported; S5 gate check specs_logged.
From aer-consistency: {{res:id:pct}} converts log points, results check flags b written as 100*b percent.
From de-AIGC-skills: audit-only / edit / author-voiced modes, one confirmation point, negation and hedge fidelity in polish check. The de-AIGC goal itself is excluded.
From aer-replication: replication-package skill, README template, package check (incl. hidden characters and Office author metadata), S12 gate check package_ready.
From Full-empirical-analysis: 8-step standard output and M1-M6 progressive main table in econometric-analysis.
From aer-referee-sim: three-question desk screen before the full review in academic-review.
From eval-harness: tests/evals scenarios with pass/fail fixture pairs, offline grading, plus chain integrity and kb_search eval (recall@k).

candidate_patterns.idea: Tasks with known answers recomputed from data (LaLonde, Card IV)
candidate_patterns.status: excluded for now: needs a real agent run per task
